info.name: LJVIS — ERRU CGR
info.description: Functional tests for the ERRU CGR module covering all stages: LJVIS2-66 (lifecycle), LJVIS2-138 (form), LJVIS2-139 (tegevused: send/resend/inbound/Heartbeat). Permission boundaries (cgr.read / cgr.create / cgr.send), 7A/7B XSD-choice validation, broadcast (ZZ) send returning 4 member-state entries, riigipohine uuestisaatmine updating only the targeted member-state entry, inbound CGR handler with UNFIT-register lookup and MTR fallback, Heartbeat no-storage guarantee, and idempotency replay.
